details:
After migrating my world project to the VCC with base and world SDK ver. 3.2.0, my video player wasn't able to open any url input windows, the VRCUrlInputField turned into a missing monoscript, re-adding the script showed the usual inspector UI, and the script is properly(?) registering an interact, but no field is opened, video's played thru the player's playlist feature function as intended, the only thing that won't work is the URL input field. I'm also aware of a few people having the exact same issue after migrating to the VCC.

Edit: On further inspection, migrating to the VCC will fail to import the VRCUrlInputField component. Re-importing the SDK via unity's context menu will re-add the component, but the issue is still present.

Further edit: A solution was found! This issue is only present in world projects that have been migrated to the VCC, worlds (with said video player) made with old assets (scene, mesh, udon scripts, ect.) that are imported into a brand new U# world project made by the VCC function perfectly.
title: VRCUrlInputField, textbox doesn't open after migrating world to VCC
